Delhi Approves Scheme to Replace Polluting Commercial Vehicles

The Delhi government has approved the 'Parivartan' scheme, aimed at phasing out old, polluting commercial vehicles. The policy will provide incentives to replace these vehicles with cleaner alternatives, such as BS-VI compliant ones. This initiative is expected to reduce air pollution in the Delhi-NCR region and benefit approximately 2.07 lakh truck and bus owners.
